g.text: One shared Streamlit process drafts threat models, looks up public vulnerability data, drafts policies, analyzes packet captures, and scans a visitor's own AI workflow with garak,

g.text: using the model provider and credential each visitor brings. The app's model calls pass the safeguards layer unless the operator turns it off; a scan's checks are the visitor's choice.
